verdict.rationale: Epic documents several official programming surfaces: a C++ gameplay API with reflection and delegates, Python editor scripting, a plugin system, and the Remote Control HTTP/WebSocket API, which can call any BlueprintCallable function. Probes confirm the Python, Remote Control and automation docs are fetchable keylessly, and llms.txt exists but is intermittently WAF-blocked. Source access is account/EULA-gated (the GitHub API returns Not Found keylessly), and community comments describe the C++ workflow as heavy and version upgrades as breaking. missing for 10: packaged client SDKs (e.g. language libraries for the Remote Control API), ungated machine-readable access to source and API reference, independent hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs.
